description: Preserved false-positive and perceptual artifact detections excluded from physical ground truth

false_positives.audit_notes: YOLO detector identified an aerial photo of an octocopter on a computer monitor display wallpaper as an active robot. High Laplacian sharpness (2164.46) was driven by sharp screen pixels/bezels rather than a 3D physical object. Excluded from inst_quadcopter_drone_001 physical ground truth.
